name: OzoneForcing
description:
Calculates the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of stratospheric and tropospheric ozone,
and of the N2O and temperature feedbacks on ozone, following MAGICC7.

# Inputs

- `Equivalent Effective Stratospheric Chlorine` (ppt): drives the stratospheric ozone ERF
- `Atmospheric Concentrations|CH4` (ppb): drives the CH4 term of the tropospheric ozone ERF
- `Atmospheric Concentrations|N2O` (ppb): drives the N2O feedback
- `Emissions|{NOx,CO,NMVOC}|{Fossil,Biosphere}` (Mt N/yr, Mt CO/yr and Mt NMVOC/yr):
  ozone precursor emissions by sector over the step
- `Surface Air Temperature Change` (K): drives the temperature feedback

# Outputs

- `Effective Radiative Forcing|Ozone|Stratospheric` (W/m^2): ERF of stratospheric ozone depletion
- `Effective Radiative Forcing|Ozone|Tropospheric` (W/m^2): ERF of tropospheric ozone,
  on the four-box grid with the `tropospheric_ozone_regions` parameter
- `Effective Radiative Forcing|Ozone|N2O Feedback` (W/m^2): ozone ERF from the N2O concentration
- `Effective Radiative Forcing|Ozone|Temperature Feedback` (W/m^2): ozone ERF from warming

# ERF terms

At the end of each year $Y$:

- Stratospheric: $s \max(0, (E_Y - E_{Y_0}) / 100)^{\beta}$ from the threshold year $Y_0$, zero before.
- Tropospheric:
  $r o_{CH4} \ln(M_Y / M_0) + r [o_{NOx} \Delta NOx_{Y-1} + o_{CO} \Delta CO_{Y-1} + o_{VOC} \Delta VOC_{Y-1}]$.
  With `tropospheric_ozone_regions` it is spread within each hemisphere, as MAGICC7 does.
- N2O feedback: $k (N_Y - N_0)$
- Temperature feedback: $\gamma T_{Y-1}$

Changes ($\Delta$) and the subscript 0 are relative to the first year of the run.
Each change is the sum of the fossil and biosphere changes, in MAGICC7's order.
Aviation NOx is not separated from other NOx.

parameters.name: stratospheric_o3_scale
parameters.description:
Stratospheric ozone scale, $s$ (MAGICC7 `STRATOZ_O3SCALE`).

unit: W/m^2

Negative because depletion cools.

parameters.name: stratospheric_cl_exponent
parameters.description:
Exponent of the EESC power law, $\beta$ (MAGICC7 `STRATOZ_CLEXPON`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: stratospheric_reference_year
parameters.description:
Threshold year $Y_0$ of the stratospheric ozone ERF (MAGICC7 `STRATOZ_THRESHOLD_YEAR`).

unit: yr

The ERF is zero before this year and relative to its EESC afterwards.

parameters.name: tropospheric_ozone_radiative_efficiency
parameters.description:
Radiative efficiency of tropospheric ozone, $r$ (MAGICC7 `TROPOZ_RADEFF_WM2PERDU`)

unit: W/m^2 per DU

parameters.name: tropospheric_ozone_ch4_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Tropospheric ozone sensitivity to CH4, $o_{CH4}$ (MAGICC7 `TROPOZ_OZCH4`)

unit: DU per unit ln(CH4/CH4_0)

parameters.name: tropospheric_ozone_nox_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Tropospheric ozone sensitivity to NOx emissions, $o_{NOx}$ (MAGICC7 `TROPOZ_OZNOX`)

unit: DU per Mt N/yr

parameters.name: tropospheric_ozone_co_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Tropospheric ozone sensitivity to CO emissions, $o_{CO}$ (MAGICC7 `TROPOZ_OZCO`)

unit: DU per Mt CO/yr

parameters.name: tropospheric_ozone_nmvoc_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Tropospheric ozone sensitivity to NMVOC emissions, $o_{VOC}$ (MAGICC7 `TROPOZ_OZVOC`)

unit: DU per Mt NMVOC/yr

parameters.name: n2o_ozone_radiative_efficiency
parameters.description:
Ozone ERF per unit N2O concentration, $k$ (MAGICC7 `OZDUETON2O_RADEFF`)

unit: W/m^2 per ppb

parameters.name: temperature_scale
parameters.description:
Ozone ERF per unit warming, $\gamma$ (MAGICC7 `OZDUETOTEMPERATURE_SCALE`)

unit: W/m^2 per K

parameters.name: tropospheric_ozone_regions
parameters.description:
Regional pattern of tropospheric ozone ERF (MAGICC7 `RF_REGIONS_TROPOZ`).

Setting it makes `Effective Radiative Forcing|Ozone|Tropospheric` a four-box output.
